name: @absolutejs/router
description: Multi-tenant connection routing primitive for Bun PaaS gateways. Consistent-hash tenant→shard, per-tenant connection cap, per-tenant rate limit, healthy-shard skip. The library that goes in front of N @absolutejs/runtime instances.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/bun.ts --outdir dist --sourcemap --target=bun && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run check:package && bun publish
